name: Cross-reference ideas
description: Suggest related passages for the selected verses
promptTemplate:
Suggest up to five passages that illuminate the selected verses.
For each give the reference and one sentence on how it relates.
If the user has selected only part of the passage, focus on that part.
Do not invent references.

name: Plain-language summary
description: Summarize the selected text in two or three simple sentences
promptTemplate:
Summarize the selected text in two or three plain sentences that a new reader would understand.
Output only the summary.
